bio: Chutnée, is found in the heart of West London on the iconic Southall Broadway also known as ‘Little India’.  Enter culture and South Asian elegance.  The perfect gateway to the vibrant world of flavours with a modern twist.  The bespoke afternoon tea by Chutnée is served in the main seating area, where you’ll be surrounded by a beautiful hand painted mural.  A chance to escape into tranquillity. Each corner of Chutnée provides a picturesque moment.  The Blossom Afternoon Tea for one is £30 per person or £55 for two people. Chutnée offers a range of savoury bites including a mini pink bun vada pav, Chicken tikka toastie, Chapli express kebab burger, shots of pani puri and classic Papri Chaat. First of its kind mini milk cakes are served with a range of handcrafted deserts. Authentic range of Chaii’s and traditional Teas are available - including one refill.  Afternoon Tea is priced at £30 per person or £55 for two.  Extras available: Pink’d (non-alcoholic mocktail) £3.95 Chutnée’s Signature Malai Chaii £2.00 per pot
